title: Dock corners and a blurred updater
summary: Fixed the dock's lower corners. InfinityUpdater now uses the top bar's blur settings, with a darker header and button area.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The lower corners now use the same outline color as the sides. The thicker top edge is unchanged.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The background uses the same blur settings as the top bar and terminal handle. The header and button area are slightly darker. Text and controls stay sharp.

changes.title: InfinityTerminal
changes.text: The handle uses the panel's actual blur instead of an estimated color. It reconnects when the panel background reloads.

changes.title: Quick Settings
changes.text: Large tray icons now fit inside their cells, including icons from apps that start later.

changes.title: GNOME 51 fixes
changes.text: Fixed an error when drawing rounded workspace previews and removed obsolete arguments from terminal window resizing.

title: Tray icons and update cancellation
summary: App tray icons moved into Quick Settings. Cancelling an installation no longer clears the update list.

changes.title: Tray layout
changes.text: App icons sit below the system controls and volume sliders. Spacing is consistent, and small groups are centered. The three-dot button was removed.

changes.title: Pin or hide an app
changes.text: Right-click an icon to pin it to the top bar, return it to Quick Settings, or hide it. These choices are saved. The tray's context menu can restore hidden apps.

changes.title: Update indicator
changes.text: InfinityUpdater stays separate from the app tray. Its badge shows the number of available updates.

changes.title: Cancelled installation
changes.text: Cancelling the password prompt keeps the available updates on screen. A failed installation reports the error instead of clearing the list.

changes.title: App menus
changes.text: Tray menus stay open during routine refreshes, and icon order is preserved when extensions reload.

title: Clock, terminal handle and lock screen
summary: Fixed clock alignment, compact-handle detection and lock-screen spacing.

changes.title: Clock
changes.text: The clock stays centered when the time changes or InfinityTerminal opens. Its position is aligned to whole pixels to avoid blurred text.

changes.title: Terminal handle
changes.text: Maximized windows now shrink the handle even when the theme leaves a small gap below the top bar.

changes.title: Lock screen
changes.text: The avatar and password field are centered together, with enough space below the large clock.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The adaptive dock has a stronger top edge. Custom border colors are preserved.

title: ARM64 and x64 images with the terminal handle
summary: Both images include the pull-down terminal handle, smaller terminal sizes and dock overlap fixes for live sessions.

changes.title: Open the terminal
changes.text: Click the handle below the clock or drag it down. Release to keep the chosen height. A short drag closes it; Escape cancels the gesture.

changes.title: Handle size
changes.text: The handle shrinks when the terminal is open or a window reaches the top bar. Overview and the lock screen hide it.

changes.title: Terminal height
changes.text: The terminal can be resized below half the screen, down to 96 pixels. Drag its lower edge up to the top bar to hide it.

changes.title: Live-session dock
changes.text: Window overlap detection now works in the live desktop and ignores minimized windows.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 images were published to R2. Older files are kept for six minutes after the download links change so cached pages can catch up.

title: Terminal pull handle
summary: InfinityTerminal can now be opened and resized by dragging from the top bar.

changes.title: Click or drag
changes.text: The handle below the clock opens the terminal with a click or downward drag. Releasing it keeps the selected height.

changes.title: Hide the terminal
changes.text: Drag the lower edge back to the top bar, make a short pull, or use the existing keyboard shortcut.

changes.title: Desktop behavior
changes.text: The handle shrinks near windows and stays centered independently of the clock layout. It follows the selected theme and reduced-motion setting.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The dock moves out of the way when a window reaches its area, including in the live session.

title: ARM64 and x64 images, NVIDIA and Steam fixes
summary: New Fedora 45 images, direct downloads and fixes for installation, Steam and the desktop tools.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 ISOs are available directly from R2. The website reads filenames, sizes and MD5/SHA-256 checksums from the release manifest.

changes.title: NVIDIA installation
changes.text: On supported x64 hardware, installation builds and checks the driver modules before finishing. Driver failures stop installation rather than appearing at first boot. This step needs an internet connection.

changes.title: Steam and TV Mode
changes.text: Both use the working Steam runtime launcher. TV-session startup and exit were corrected. Steam stays closed after setup so its first update can finish from the desktop.

changes.title: InfinitySetup and InfinityConfig
changes.text: Setup opens on the System tab and searches across categories. Config's unused search bar was removed. Both apps have their own icons, and grouped setup changes need one administrator authorization.

changes.title: InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Added configurable system readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone. The widget row can be reordered. The terminal now starts its opening animation fully above the screen.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater
changes.text: Adjusted the opening animation and button contrast in both themes. Offline updates now show a restart notification. Restart handling and completion messages were fixed.

changes.title: Desktop
changes.text: Adjusted desktop and dock icon sizes and mounted-drive artwork. NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher are included.

changes.title: Live installer
changes.text: Firefox opens the changelog instead of the Fedora start page.
